paper.title: Logarithmic Regret for Unconstrained Submodular Maximization Stochastic Bandit

settings.name_in_paper: Online unconstrained submodular maximization (Online USM) with stochastic (full-)bandit feedback
unmapped: Action set is the full power set P(D) of d items (unconstrained)
Mean reward is a non-monotone submodular set function f: P(D) -> [0, c], with range bound c known to the learner
Regret is the 1/2-approximate pseudo-regret sum_t [f(A*)/2 - f(A_t)]
Single noisy scalar feedback per action (full-bandit), noise sigma^2-sub-Gaussian conditionally on the past, sigma known
settings.definition_quote: The player receives noisy rewards from a non monotone submodular set-function $f: \cP(\cD)\rightarrow [0, c]$ with $c>0$. At each round $t\in[T]$, the player chooses an action $A_t\in\cP(\cD)$ and receives $Z_t = f(A_t) + \eta_t$, where $\eta_t$ is a random variable. Let $\sigma>0$ (known), we assume that $\eta_t$ is $\sigma^2$-sub-Gaussian conditionally to the past ... $R_T = \sum_{t=1}^T\Big[\frac{1}{2}f(A^*) - f(A_t)\Big]$

symbols.H_f: global DG-hardness: sum over items of local hardness h_{f,i} = max_X (alpha_+ + beta_+)^2/(alpha_+ - beta_+)^4

source.label: th:DGETC
source.quote: Then, with probability greater than $1-10\delta/T$, \DGETC satisfies \[ R_T \leq C_1\min\Big\{H_f\log(dT),\ dT^{2/3}\log(dT)^{1/3}\Big\}\,, \] where $C_1$ is a constant independent from $d$, $T$ and $\delta$.

results.notes: Regret is the 1/2-approximate pseudo-regret. Constant C_1 claimed independent of delta though the proof's g_{T,delta} depends on log(1/delta); recorded as O.

results.notes: Problem-free branch of the min in Theorem 2 (1/2-approximate regret).

symbols.H_f: global DG-hardness (sum of local DG-hardnesses h_{f,i})

source.label: th:DGETC
source.quote: Likewise, in expectation, \[ \bE[R_T] \leq C_2 \min\Big\{H_f\log(dT),\ dT^{2/3}\log(dT)^{1/3}\Big\}\,, \] where $C_1$ is a constant independent from $d$ and $T$.

results.notes: Expectation obtained by choosing delta=1 per the analysis. 1/2-approximate pseudo-regret.
Problem-free branch of the expectation bound.

symbols.h_i: local DG-hardness h_{f,i} of item i; sum is over the d items

source.quote: we can keep the per-item granularity to get with probability at least $1-10\delta/T$ \begin{align*} R_T\leq C_3 \sum_{i\in[d]}\min\Big\{h_{f,i}\log(dT),\ T^{2/3}\log(dT)^{1/3}\Big\}\,, \end{align*} where $C_3$ is a constant independent from $d$, $T$ and $\delta$.

results.notes: Stated in a remark rather than a theorem; sum over items (d of them) written as sum_arms.
